channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Former Energy Minister detained at border in Ukraine's biggest corruption case, NABU says
item.description: Former Energy Minister Herman Halushchenko was detained while attempting to cross the state border, the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) said on Feb. 15.

item.title: Ukraine and Russia in the Epstein files | Ukraine This Week
item.description: In the latest episode of Ukraine This Week, the Kyiv Independent’s Anna Belokur examines how Ukraine appears in recently released Jeffrey Epstein files. The files reference flight arrangements for models linked to Kyiv agencies, a failed real estate deal in Lviv, and brief mentions of Ukraine’s 2019 presidential election.

item.title: Russia revives election-day truce offer, proposes UN rule for Ukraine
item.description: Russia said it is ready to halt strikes on Ukraine for a single day of voting and floated UN-backed "temporary external governance," after Zelensky said elections could be held following two months of a ceasefire.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack targets multiple Russian oblasts, Bryansk reportedly left largely without electricity
item.description: Russian officials reported a large-scale drone attack targeting multiple regions on Feb. 15, including areas near Moscow and Bryansk Oblasts.

item.title: 'Mass obstruction' — Draft officers injured in Odesa following confrontation with 'civilian group'
item.description: Multiple enlistment officers were hospitalized after a "group of civilians" allegedly carried out an attack on the personnel in Odesa on Feb. 15, the Odesa Oblast Regional Recruitment Center reported.

item.title: 'Air defense is a daily necessity' — Zelensky says additional aid packages expected by Feb. 24 following return from Munich
item.description: "There were many meetings, and most importantly – there will be new support packages for Ukraine. The key priority is missiles for air defense, for protection against ballistic missiles," Zelensky said in his evening address on Feb. 15.

item.title: Russian attacks on Sumy Oblast injure 4, damage 'medical infrastructure'
item.description: Sumy Oblast Governor Oleh Hryhoriv reported that a Russian drone targeted unspecified "medical infrastructure" in the city of Sumy overnight on Feb. 14-15, causing damage to the target.

item.title: Ex-energy minister charged in Ukraine's biggest corruption case
item.description: Herman Halushchenko, Ukraine's former energy minister, was charged of money laundering and involvement in a criminal group as part of the country's major corruption scandal, the National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) announced on Feb. 16.
